NEW YORK LIFE INSURANCE AND ANNUITY CORPORATION
Consumer Electronic Consent and Disclosure
IMPORTANT— PLEASE READ CAREFULLY
YOUR ACTION MAY BE REQUIRED KEEP FOR FUTURE REFERENCE
What are the purpose and impact of this Electronic Consent and Disclosure? You are applying for an annuity contract (“Annuity”) issued by New York Life Insurance and Annuity Corporation (“New York Life”). You have expressed your desire to conduct business electronically with regard to the purchase of this Annuity (“purchase of this Annuity” is referred to herein as “Transaction”). To do so, you must provide New York Life with your consent. By clicking “Sign” below, you will be providing New York Life with your consent:
(a) To execute via electronic means the documents that are described in this Consumer Electronic Consent and Disclosure (“Consent”); and
(b) To all the terms and conditions set forth below in this Consent. I agree that my use of a keypad, mouse, or other device to (i) select or click “Sign” or similar act, or (ii) communicate my approval of any agreement, acknowledgement, consent terms, disclosures, or conditions constitutes my signature, acceptance, and agreement as if actually signed by me in writing. I also agree that no certification of authority or other third-party verification is necessary to validate my e-signature and that the lack of such certification or third-party verification will not in any way affect the validity of my e-signature or any resulting contract between me and New York Life. I also agree that my e-signature is the legal equivalent of my manual signature on the Agreement as well as any documents attached to this electronic communication, and that I consent to be legally bound thereby. If you do not want to execute via electronic means the documents that are described in this Consent, or if you do not agree with all the terms and conditions of this Consent, you may not conduct the Transaction electronically, and you should not click “Sign” below. Note: Your consent is voluntary. If you do not click “Sign” below you will be given the opportunity to conduct the Transaction by non- electronic means.
What does this Consent cover once I sign it? This Consent covers your agreement to all the terms and conditions of this Consent, including your agreement to:
NYLA007906583

1. Execute via electronic means the documents associated with the Transaction that New York Life is required by law to provide or make available to you in writing (“Required Documents”), as well as other information and documents associated with the Transaction (collectively, “Other Documents”); and
2. Be bound with the same force and effect as if you had manually affixed your signature on paper when you click “Sign” or otherwise apply your e-signature to Required Documents or Other Documents.
   While not a complete listing, the types of Required Documents that may be made available to you electronically include:

* The Annuity application and related documents;
* Prospectuses and other required disclosure statements associated with this Transaction; and
* Privacy rights notices associated with this Transaction
  Can I get paper copies of the Required Documents and Other Documents?
  Yes. New York Life will provide you with paper copies of any of the Required Documents or Other Documents at the completion of the Transaction.
  Should I maintain copies of the Required Documents and Other Documents?
  Yes. In connection with this Transaction, you should print or save this Consent and all Required Documents and Other Documents, and keep printed or electronic copies of them for your records. If you have any trouble with printing or saving, you should contact New York Life.
  How long will this Consent remain in effect?
  This Consent shall become effective once you click “Sign” below. This Consent will terminate upon execution of the Transaction and all the documents related to it, or earlier if (i) you withdraw your consent (as described in the next section) or (ii) the Transaction is terminated or canceled.
  What if I change my mind?
  Because this Consent only applies to obtaining your signature relating to this specific Transaction, it is unlikely you will ever need to withdraw it. However, if prior to the execution of the documents related to the Transaction you would like to terminate this Consent, you will need to notify New York Life. You may terminate this Consent at any time and without charge by contacting New York Life, as instructed below. A revocation will be made effective when received by New York Life. What if my email address changes?
  Because this Consent only applies to obtaining your signature relating to this specific Transaction, we believe it is unlikely that your email address will change during the brief period of time this Consent is effective. However, if your email address changes prior to the termination of this Consent, you should inform New York Life using the information provided below.

### Annuity Purchase Checklist

To ensure that your paperwork is processed quickly, please be sure the items in the checklist below are complete and that the necessary information is included. Incomplete or missing paperwork may cause delays.
Annuity Paperwork Checklist
Signing your application and/or forms
All owners and annuitants, if applicable, must review, sign, and date all forms. Please be sure to check all pages for required signatures and dates, as they may be needed in multiple locations.
If applicable, review the copy of the income illustration provided for accuracy.
Returning your paperwork
Time-sensitive materials. Rates may change without notice, so please return as soon as possible.
Adding payments to an existing Diversified Income Annuity (DIA) contract
Review the copy of the income illustration provided for accuracy. Verify that the illustration reflects the same income start date as your existing contract.
Return your completed paperwork to a Fidelity Investor Center near you or to:
Regular Mail Fidelity Investments Life Insurance Company Annuity Service Center PO Box 770001 Cincinnati, OH 45277-0050
Overnight Mail Fidelity Investments Life Insurance Company Annuity Service Center 100 Crosby Parkway, MZ KC2Q Covington, KY 41015
Thank you for choosing Fidelity for your retirement income needs. If you have any questions about completing the required paperwork, or need to make a change or correction, please contact your Advisor or call us at 800.544.2442.
If you are exchanging your existing annuity, please contact a Fidelity Representative to see if your current insurance provider requires additional paperwork. Guarantees are subject to the claims-paying ability of the issuing insurance company. Principal value and investment returns of a variable annuity will fluctuate and you may have a gain or loss when money is withdrawn.

Single Premium Deferred Annuity (SPDA) Product Details (Please see the fact sheet of the annuity you are considering for more complete information.)

* Deferred fixed annuity that provides a guaranteed rate of return for a set period of time
* Tax-deferred growth\*
* If the contract is renewed at the end of the guarantee period, the renewal rates of return are not guaranteed and may be significantly lower
* Ability to annuitize assets and receive guaranteed income payments for life. Annuitization rates fluctuate at the discretion of the carrier; however, they all contain a guaranteed minimum rate
* Single premium annuity — additional premium payments are not permitted
* A surrender charge and market value adjustment† may apply to withdrawals before the end of the guarantee period
  • Certain annuities allow owners to withdraw a limited amount each year without incurring a surrender charge or market value adjustment
* Withdrawals of taxable amounts are subject to ordinary income tax, and, if taken before age 59½, may be subject to a 10% IRS penalty
* If funded with after-tax assets in a non-qualified contract, for tax purposes earnings are generally required to be withdrawn first, followed by cost basis‡
* Deferred fixed annuities distributed by Fidelity may provide additional benefits, including additional benefits through the purchase of contract riders
* Guarantees are subject to the claims-paying ability of the issuing insurance company
* Tax deferral offers no additional value if a fixed annuity is used to fund a tax-qualified plan, such as a 401(k) or IRA, and may not be available if the annuity is owned by a non-natural person such as a corporation or certain types of trusts.
  † A market value adjustment decreases or increases the amount the Client receives from a withdrawal based on interest rate conditions at the time. ‡ Fidelity does not provide legal or tax advice. The information herein is general in nature and should not be considered legal or tax advice. Consult an attorney or tax professional regarding your specific situation.

What investment services and advice can you provide me? FBS offers brokerage accounts and services to retail investors, including for personal and retirement investing, and cash management services (such as bill pay, checkwriting, and margin lending). FBS accounts allow you to invest in mutual funds, exchange-traded funds (“ETFs”), stocks, bonds, college savings plans and insurance products, among others. We do not limit our offerings to Fidelity funds, specific asset classes, or funds of sponsors or investment managers who compensate us. There is no minimum investment to open an account; there are minimums to purchase some types of investments. FBS works with its affiliated clearing broker, National Financial Services LLC, along with other affiliates to provide you with these investment services. For additional information about the products and services Fidelity offers, or may recommend to you, see the Products, Services, and Conflicts of Interest document and other information found at Fidelity.com/information. With an FBS brokerage account, unless we agree otherwise in writing, you are solely responsible for deciding how you want to invest, placing orders, and monitoring your account. FBS, either by itself or through an affiliate, can provide you with tools and information to help you make decisions and can provide you with investment recommendations for certain investments upon request. Investment advisory services are provided through our affiliated investment advisers, including Strategic Advisers LLC (“Strategic Advisers”) and Fidelity Institutional Wealth Adviser LLC (“FIWA”), typically for a fee, and documents describing these advisory services can be found at Fidelity.com/information, including the Strategic Advisers and FIWA client relationship summaries. FBS brokerage accounts are also available to you when you work with a third-party adviser such as a registered investment adviser, retirement plan administrator, bank or family office (“intermediaries”). If you open your FBS brokerage account through an intermediary, you or your intermediary will make all decisions regarding the purchase or sale of investments; FBS will not provide recommendations or monitor your investment decisions, or your intermediary, for you. Some intermediaries limit the investment products and services available to you. Please contact us or your intermediary for more information on the available services and investments, conflicts of interest, and any fees you will pay.

When commissions apply, you will be charged more when there are more trades in your account, and FBS therefore has an incentive to encourage you to trade more often and in larger amounts. FBS will also collect fees for margin loans based on current interest rates and your average margin loan balance.

  recommendations for retirement accounts. This document also describes the conflicts of interest that arise in FBS’s business, including
  those conflicts that arise from compensation received by FBS, its affiliates, and its registered representatives (“Representatives”), and how
  we address those conflicts.

  are also solely responsible for the ongoing review and monitoring of the investments held in your FBS Account, even if FBS has
  made a recommendation to you. It is important you understand that FBS is not an investment advisor and is not required to update
  any previously provided recommendations, and that unless specifically agreed to in writing, FBS will not monitor any investment

  for it are solely responsible for directing all of the entity’s account activity, including selecting and monitoring its investments, and
  must do so independent of, and without reliance on, any advice, recommendation or guidance provided by FBS.
  When providing brokerage services to you, FBS is required to:
  • Have reasonable grounds to believe that any security, investment strategy, or account type that we specifically recommend to you

  time horizon, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, and other financial information you have disclosed to us (your “Investment Profile”)

  • Treat you in a manner consistent with principles of fair dealing and high standards of honesty and integrity.
